title:
It’s nearly holiday time! 🕰️ 🌞🌎

Holiday fever is at Blue Pits Housing Action for our trip to Wales in two weeks! 

Holidays,  serve as a valuable component of our lives. Our tenants vote every few months for which holidays, trips and days out they want us to book 📖 

Holidays and days out, provide a respite from our daily routines, boost our mental health, and create an environment for strengthening bonds and making memories 👍🌸⭐️

#bluepitshousingaction #holiday
#wales #caravan #socialcare #supportworkers
